data.long_meaning: Derived from the Greek word 'agreas' meaning 'peaceful' or 'harmonious'. The name Agretha has been used in Christian tradition to represent a person who is agreeable and peaceful, making it an ideal name for a baby girl. The name Agretha carries the meaning “Agreeable, peaceful” and is chosen by families in Christian traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Biblical tradition and is also used in English, Greek, Latin. Parents who choose Agretha usually hope their child will grow to embody agreeable, peaceful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
